title: Rawy Baranco, Mach4Food: “The impact of equipment deserves greater attention”
summary: Rawy José Baranco is Manager of Sales and Co-Founder at Mach4Food, a family-owned company based in the Netherlands specialising in the international trade of used and refurbished machinery for the metal packaging industry.. He was selected for the Future Leaders Class of 2027 by Paris Packaging Week. Can you briefly introduce yourself?
